{{- /* [CAP:access] → see caps/access/manifest.json Prefer mdfAccessInfo (Foundry plan) so inherited protection works without page-level access: param. */ -}} {{- $page := . -}} {{- $html := "" -}} {{- if reflect.IsMap . -}} {{- $page = index . "Page" -}} {{- $html = index . "HTML" | default "" -}} {{- else -}} {{- $html = .Content -}} {{- end -}} {{- $info := mdfAccessInfo $page -}} {{- if $info -}} {{- $api := $info.api | default "" -}} {{- if not $api -}} {{- with $page.Site.Params.mdfriday -}} {{- $api = .api | default .apiBaseUrl | default "" -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if not $api -}} {{- $api = $page.Site.Params.mdfriday_api | default "https://api.mdfriday.com" -}} {{- end -}} {{- with $page.Params.teaser -}} {{- /* Teaser is plain text (Foundry has no markdownify). Escape via default print. */ -}}
{{ . }}
{{- end -}} {{- partial "access-card.html" $page -}} {{- $attrs := mdfAccessEncrypt $page $html -}} {{- if $attrs -}}
{{- else -}}
{{- end -}} {{- else if eq $page.Params.access "protected" -}} {{- /* Fallback when SSG access runtime was not started */ -}} {{- partial "access-card.html" $page -}}
{{- else -}} {{- $html | safeHTML -}} {{- end -}}
